data.title: Refusal of exemption to drive on forest road "Am Hochries"
data.summary: The district office (Landratsamt Beispielkreis) wrote on 2 December 2025 to refuse your application of 14 October 2025 for an exemption to drive a motor vehicle on the forest road "Am Hochries". No costs are charged.
data.explanation: Your application for a permit to drive on the closed forest road was rejected. The office says the road is closed to general motor traffic and that you did not show a special need, since your property can be reached via the municipal road. You may decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or for the record at the office that issued the decision. The app shows until when you can do this. If you are unsure, consider seeking professional advice.

items.consequence: After the deadline the refusal becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
